name: flashpi/flashpi-php
description: The official PHP SDK for Flashpi, the electronic invoicing API for Ecuador's SRI.

suggest.ext-curl: Enforces each attempt's deadline over the whole answer, headers included, and notices an answer cut short

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Runs PHPStan at the highest level.
scripts-descriptions.openapi:check: Fails when src/Types/ApiTypes.php does not match openapi/openapi.json.
scripts-descriptions.openapi:sync: Downloads the public OpenAPI document, then regenerates the types.
scripts-descriptions.package:check: Checks what Composer would install from the archive of HEAD (commit first).
scripts-descriptions.readme:check: Fails when tests/Examples/Readme does not match the READMEs.
scripts-descriptions.readme:generate: Rewrites tests/Examples/Readme from the php blocks of the READMEs.
scripts-descriptions.test:live: Runs tests/Live against the real API in test mode (needs FLASHPI_TEST_API_KEY and FLASHPI_DEMO_ISSUER_ID).
